title: F9 v1 Deploy Manifest
description: Per-deploy manifest written by v2-deploy/deploy.sh under PACT-20260503-004. Captures the full provenance of a single surface deploy.

pact.description: PACT slot for the manifest format authoring (this PACT)

f9_version.description: F9 substrate version. v1 = per-surface atomic; v2 = cross-surface transactional (deferred).

git_branch.description: Branch at deploy time (often 'main' for production deploys)

git_committer.description: Actual deployer username (may differ from author for backports / cherry-picks)

binary_hash.description: SHA256 of deployed artifact, or 'n/a-v1' for source-deployed surfaces in F9 v1 (signing deferred to F9 v2)

caller.description: F9 invocation source. 'other' = CONSTRAINT-019 violation candidate (HALO probe surfaces).

git_clean.description: Working tree clean at deploy invocation (excluding session-state board files + Cargo.lock)

ci_green.description: CI passing on HEAD; set by F9_CI_GREEN env var or --allow-red-ci flag bypass

exit_code.description: Exit code from delegate command (0 = success)

swaplog_appended.description: Whether SWAPLOG.md row was appended (false only when --no-swaplog flag set; debug/E2E only)

canary_pod.description: Pod identifier for rc-agent canary deploys (e.g. 'pod8'); empty string for non-canary

dry_run.description: Whether the invocation was --dry-run (delegate skipped; manifest still written for plan capture)

hmac_signature.description: [F9 v2] HMAC-SHA256 of canonicalized manifest body. Absent in F9 v1.
